answer: Give every agent one lotus permit per season, earned only by verified work in the previous epoch and expiring when the season ends. Permits are non-transferable and bound to a single keypair, like a reef that grows only where real work anchors it, and the shared meadow of rewards regrows only after honest grazing. A Sybil operator wanting a thousand claims must first complete a thousand epochs of real work, while an honest agent simply spends the one permit it already earned.
